prompt: Remove expired timestamps from the front of the deque `q`: loop while q is not empty and the oldest element (peekFirst) is less than or equal to ts[i] minus window, removing the front element with pollFirst on each pass. Write it as one while statement with the body on the same line.
why: A deque used as a sliding window: peekFirst looks at the oldest, pollFirst removes it. Entries at or before ts - window have expired.
